exceptions: Preparation predates the Mass and has no source cue.
Collect, Epistle, Gospel, Preface and Postcommunion slots are variable and require verified day/feast Proper.
Solemn, Sung and Low form semantics and historical ceremonies cannot be inferred merely from matching Latin cue IDs.
Dujardin's 1889 English passage references are transcription-level, not original page-image verified.
Last Gospel John 1 is not guaranteed on every special day.
None of the editorial Bible suggestions supplied for Dujardin are claimed to be Dujardin's own chapter:verse citations.
